display.title: Chof-Hey Elul: The World Was Created for You
display.summary_short: Why the world was created on the 25th of Elul, why Rosh Hashanah marks the sixth day, and why every child should know the world was created for him.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show broadcast on 24 Elul, just before Rosh Hashanah. Uncle Yossi asks when Hashem created the world: not on Rosh Hashanah, but five days earlier, on the 25th of Elul, which begins that night. Rosh Hashanah is the sixth day of Creation, when Hashem made Adam and Chavah, the most important creatures, last of all so they would find a complete world prepared for them. They were placed in the world 'to work it and guard it', which the Sages explain as the 248 positive and 365 negative mitzvos. That is what Rosh Hashanah is about: we hear the shofar, accept Hashem as our King, resolve to serve Him better, and are blessed with a good and sweet year. As the Rebbe said, now is the time for simcha, which will bring Moshiach.
display.lesson: The whole world was created for you, so that you can serve Hashem with Torah and mitzvos; greet the new year with resolutions and simcha.
